# NexMess

> Cloud-based smart mess management platform for shared living, bachelor messes, and student hostels in English and Bengali.

NexMess helps roommates and mess managers track daily lunch and dinner meals with automatic cut-off locks, split bazaar and fixed utility bills, rotate shopping duties, export monthly PDF financial archives, and coordinate in real time.

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://www.nexmess.shop/): Overview of NexMess features and interactive meal/cost preview.
- [FAQ](https://www.nexmess.shop/faq): Frequently asked questions about meal cut-offs, meal rate calculation, deposits, and privacy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nexmess.shop/privacy-policy): Data collection, storage, and security practices.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.nexmess.shop/terms-of-service): Platform usage terms and responsibilities.
- [Sign In](https://www.nexmess.shop/login): Access an existing NexMess account.
- [Create Account](https://www.nexmess.shop/register): Register a new account to create or join a mess.

## Core Capabilities

- Daily meal toggles (Lunch & Dinner) with automatic 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM (UTC+6) cut-off timers and guest meal tracking.
- Automated meal rate calculation, fixed utility splitting, and peer-to-peer settlement summaries.
- Weekly bazaar duty rotation and meal menu schedule.
- Real-time group chat, pinned notice board, and monthly PDF financial reports.
- Full English and Bengali (বাংলা) localization with offline-ready PWA support.
